## 4. Academic Research & Publications
1. **The Application of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in Developing an Intelligent Risk Management Platform: A Case Study at Statistics Jawa Timur**
   - Authors: I Putu Agus Wahyu Dupayana, et al.
   - Publisher: Proceedings of The International Conference on Data Science and Official Statistics (ICDSOS), 2025(1), pp. 281-292.
   - DOI: https://doi.org/10.34123/icdsos.v2025i1.591
   - Summary: Explores how enterprise LLMs combined with high-accuracy vector search and retrieval-augmented generation streamline institutional risk assessment and regulatory compliance.

2. **Development of a Web-Based Activity Agenda Management Information System at Statistics of Nusa Tenggara Barat Province**
   - Authors: I Putu Agus Wahyu Dupayana, et al.
   - Publisher: Seminar Nasional Official Statistics, 2024(1), pp. 499-510.
   - DOI: https://doi.org/10.34123/semnasoffstat.v2024i1.2041
   - Summary: Designs an integrated scheduling, room reservation, and multi-department activity agenda platform with role-based access control (RBAC).
